8 اغتِزاهُ : see 1, first sentence. ＝
-A2- اغتزى بِفُلَانٍ He had such a one peculiarly to himself from among his companions: (K, TA:) like اِغْتَزَّ بِهِ. (TA.) A poet says, “ قَدْ يَغْتَزِى الهِجْرَانُ بِالتَّجَرُّمِ
” [Sometimes, or often, the cutting off from friendly intercourse has the accusation of that which is a crime, or a fault, or an offence, peculiarly assigned to it (as the cause)]: التجرّم here meaning اِدِّعَآءُ الجُرْمِ. (TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
